profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at NVIDIA
profile.summary: Interested in parallel computing on GPU. Proficient in high performance and system programming

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed back-end and front-end systems for Salary Aggregation page.
- Developed system for sending emails and mobile notifications to users.
Skills: Java Spring, Python, Pandas

positions.title: Research Fellow
positions.description:
- Studied different convolution algorithms using GPU in Deep Learning (DL) networks and how these methods are implemented in DL libraries, in particular Caffe.
- Studied the Boids simulation problem on GPU and developed algorithms to improve the performance for GPUFlame simulation framework
- Developed GPU & multi-GPU implementation for the NEST Brain simulator
Skills: GPU, Nvidia CUDA and toolkits (nvcc, cuda-gdb, profiler, Nsight), OpenCL, Google profiler

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Course: Parallel computing on MPI, OpenMP, CUDA

positions.title: Back-end Developer
positions.description:
- Developed a high performance web crawler which can handle hundreds of concurrent connections for the Web Search Engine system.
- Developed and maintained a server system for the Mobile Service serving millions of users.
- Built a data caching server which can serve thousands of requests per second for the Mobile Service system.
Skills: C/C++, STL, Python, multi-threaded programming, socket programming, MySQL, svn, Linux toolchain (gcc, Makefile, gdb, etc.), JSON, redis, memcached, Hadoop, Hypertable, HBase
